تعتمدن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَمِدْنَ (taʕtamidna) /taʕ.ta.mid.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# تُعْتَمَدْنَ (tuʕtamadna) /tuʕ.ta.mad.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
